speaker: presidenta
text: Good afternoon. The Vice-President and I welcome you to our press conference.

speaker: presidenta
text: The Governing Council today decided to keep the three key ECB interest rates unchanged.

speaker: presidenta
text: Inflation has continued to decline, but domestic price pressures remain high.

speaker: presidenta
text: We will continue to follow a data-dependent approach in determining the appropriate level and duration of restriction.

speaker: vicepresidente
text: Let me add a few words on the economic outlook.

speaker: periodista
text: My question is about the inflation outlook.

speaker: presidenta
text: Thank you for your question. We see inflation gradually returning to our two per cent target.

speaker: presidenta
text: However, there are upside risks from energy prices and wage growth.

speaker: vicepresidente
text: Financial conditions remain broadly stable, though we monitor vulnerabilities closely.
